material_scope: Unique material names per model; materials within a spawned instance may be intentionally shared by matching semantic region. Runtime must clone material objects per instance before tint changes.
tint_semantics: baseColorFactor multiplies preserved base-color textures; untextured material factors directly set surface color.

map_policy: Original basecolor, roughness, normal, AO and glazing emission channels retained where originally supplied.
lod_tint_transfer: Carry a semantic tint multiplier across LODs, not a raw factor. For each mapped slot, RGB = that LOD slot default RGB × chosen semantic tint RGB; keep original alpha. This preserves different authored base defaults.
